<init>(Path path, Limits limits, Observer observer) throws IOException {
    this.limits = java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(limits);
    this.observer = java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(observer);
    if (!Files.isRegularFile(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || Files.size(path) > limits.compressedBytes() || Files.size(path) >= (1L << 48)) throw new IOException("Require a regular BAM within its declared byte bound and the48-bit BGZF address space");
    in = new Bgzf(path, limits, observer);
    try {
        if (!Arrays.equals(exact(in, 4), new byte[]{'B', 'A', 'M', 1})) throw new IOException("BAM magic differs");
        int hl = integer(in);
        if (hl < 1 || hl > limits.headerBytes()) throw new IOException("BAM header size is outside limits");
        String text = utf8(exact(in, hl));
        long dictionaryBytes = 4;
        nr = integer(in);
        if (nr < 0 || nr >= 16384) throw new IOException("Require fewer than16384 references in this Sambamba-compatible profile");
        /*missing*/ labels = new ArrayList<String>();
        /*missing*/ seen = new HashSet<String>();
        /*missing*/ referenceLengths = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < nr; i++) {
            int n = integer(in);
            if (n < 2 || n > limits.headerBytes() || dictionaryBytes + 8 + n > limits.dictionaryBytes()) throw new IOException("Reference-name/dictionary size exceeds limits");
            byte[] name = exact(in, n);
            if (name[n - 1] != 0) throw new IOException("Reference name lacks NUL termination");
            for (int j = 0; j < n - 1; j++) if (name[j] == 0) throw new IOException("Embedded NUL reference name");
            String label = utf8(Arrays.copyOf(name, n - 1));
            if (!seen.add(label)) throw new IOException("Repeated binary reference name");
            int length = integer(in);
            if (length < 1) throw new IOException("Invalid reference length");
            labels.add(label);
            referenceLengths.add(length);
            dictionaryBytes += 8 + n;
        }
        names = List.copyOf(labels);
        lengths = List.copyOf(referenceLengths);
        parseHeader(text, names, lengths);
    } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error failure) {
        try {
            in.close();
        } catch (IOException close) {
            failure.addSuppressed(close);
        }
        throw failure;
    }
}

<init>(Path path, Limits limits) throws IOException {
    this.limits = java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(limits);
    if (!Files.isRegularFile(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || Files.size(path) > limits.compressedBytes) throw new IOException("Require a regular BAM within the compressed-byte limit: " + path);
    in = new Bgzf(path, limits);
    try {
        if (!Arrays.equals(exact(in, 4), new byte[]{'B', 'A', 'M', 1})) throw new IOException("BAM magic differs");
        int hl = integer(in);
        if (hl < 1 || hl > limits.headerBytes) throw new IOException("BAM header size is outside limits");
        String text = utf8(exact(in, hl));
        /*missing*/ dict = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        nr = integer(in);
        if (nr < 0 || nr >= 16384) throw new IOException("Require fewer than16384 references, as in the original markdup source");
        dict.write(le(nr));
        /*missing*/ names = new ArrayList<String>();
        /*missing*/ seen = new HashSet<String>();
        /*missing*/ referenceLengths = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < nr; i++) {
            int n = integer(in);
            if (n < 2 || n > limits.headerBytes || (long)dict.size() + 8 + n > limits.dictionaryBytes) throw new IOException("Reference-name/dictionary size exceeds the declared limits");
            byte[] name = exact(in, n);
            if (name[n - 1] != 0) throw new IOException("Reference name lacks NUL termination");
            for (int j = 0; j < n - 1; j++) if (name[j] == 0) throw new IOException("Embedded NUL reference name");
            String label = utf8(Arrays.copyOf(name, n - 1));
            if (!seen.add(label)) throw new IOException("Repeated binary reference name");
            int length = integer(in);
            if (length < 1) throw new IOException("Invalid reference length");
            names.add(label);
            referenceLengths.add(length);
            dict.write(le(n));
            dict.write(name);
            dict.write(le(length));
        }
        lengths = List.copyOf(referenceLengths);
        dictionary = dict.toByteArray();
        header = parseHeader(text, names, lengths);
    } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error failure) {
        try {
            in.close();
        } catch (IOException close) {
            failure.addSuppressed(close);
        }
        throw failure;
    }
}
